observed.bundle_result: AppImage failed with only 'failed to run linuxdeploy'; underlying tool stdout/stderr were absent.

upstream_source.binding: The installed CLI's published Cargo.lock pins this exact bundler version/checksum; the downloaded source archive matched it.
upstream_source.cause_of_missing_output: CLI bundle.rs maps verbosity0 to spawned log_level=Error. linux/appimage/linuxdeploy.rs then calls Command::output(), discards stdout/stderr and emits only the generic failure. One --verbose selects output_ok(), which preserves the actual tool failure and emits its output through the CLI logger.
upstream_source.fuse: The pinned bundler already supplies APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 and --appimage-extract-and-run. A missing FUSE package is not an evidenced cause.

implementation.behavior: The actual Tauri command uses --verbose and the native owned capture boundary. It preserves wall1800s/idle300s/cleanup10s and a16MiB output budget. Complete bounded transcripts are redacted before retention and before console tails are clipped to16KiB per stream at UTF8 boundaries. Actual nonzero exits and failed capture remain errors.
implementation.scope: Pinned tools, Ubuntu packages, AppImage/Debian and other native bundle requirements, signature policy and installer verification remain unchanged.
